'''Darz Varad''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior of the group of disenfranchised Mandalorians known as the [[Hidden Chain]] who opposed [[Mandalore the Avenger]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Darz! What is happening? Something is affecting the machine.|Heta Kol to Darz Varad.|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.9}}</ref> the [[Eternal Alliance]] launched [[Battle of Khar Shian|an attack]] on the Hidden Chain's base on Khar Shian, after [[Heta Kol]] allied herself with [[Darth Jadus]] and built the full-scale version of [[Darth Nul]]'s machine. At the same time, [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] infiltrated the [[Naga Sadow's fortress]] with her team and began killing any Hidden Chain members they could find. When the Alliance strike team disabled the shields that protected the fortress, Heta panicked and demanded a status update from Darz. As he was deeper in the tunnels, Varad responded that the shields were down and the base was under attack, but before he could finish his sentence, Vizla's party ambushed him and stabbed him through the back with a blade, killing the warrior.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darz Varad first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', as part of "Game Update 7.9: Legacy Reborn," released on [[June 2]], [[2026]].<ref name="7.9">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260602-0|text=Game Update 7.9 "Legacy Reborn" is live!}}</ref>
